::: {.research-intro}
David's research draws on education policy and economics. Using large administrative datasets and, where possible, experimental or quasi-experimental designs, he studies what makes teaching effective and how policy can help schools recruit, develop, and keep a strong and racially diverse teaching workforce.

::: {.brief-note}
**Short on time?** Shorter, plain-language versions of many of these studies are available from the [Maryland Equity Project](https://education.umd.edu/research/centers/mep) and the [Maryland Longitudinal Data System Center](https://mldscenter.maryland.gov/Research&ReportingSummaries.html).
:::
:::
